title: Generalized Anxiety Disorder Scale (GAD-7)
about: Anxiety screening: seven questions scored 0 to 21. The answers can be typed into OpenEMR's GAD-7 encounter form (enable it under Administration > Forms > Forms Administration).

licence.terms: No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.
licence.permission: None needed: the statement printed on the instrument.

blocks.label: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
items: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

blocks.label: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?

blocks.text: Published severity (Spitzer 2006): 5 or more, mild; 10 or more, moderate; 15 or more, severe anxiety. A total of 10 or more is the usual point to assess for generalized anxiety disorder.
